review.assessment: This change introduces `src/lib.rs` with a character-by-character scanner that accumulates digits into a string and splits on commas to build the result vector. While it preserves the existing positive-number test, it incorrectly ignores the minus sign when parsing negative integers, directly violating the stated requirement to support negative values. The logic remains fundamentally unidiomatic despite the cleanup attempt.

findings.defect: Negative numbers lose their sign because '-' is not treated as part of the number and gets dropped.
